component.name: anchor
component.summary: Browse your Stremio addons and watch in your own mpv

description.p: anchor is a native Stremio client. Sign in with your Stremio account and it shows your library and the catalogs of your addons, and plays every stream in your own mpv, so your mpv.conf, scripts, shaders and Dolby Vision handling apply.

ul.li: Home opens on what you left unfinished, then a row per catalog
Every catalog of your addons in the sidebar, by genre, page by page
Search across every catalog that can search
Movie and series pages with seasons, episodes and watched marks
Your stream addon's list as it writes it, the last stream selected
Progress written back to your Stremio account as you watch

description.p: The login key stays in the system keychain. anchor brings no content of its own: it plays what your addons offer. It needs mpv installed.
